run_convert_gemma3_checkpoint: run the CLI script to convert a Gemma3 Orbax checkpoint to HuggingFace safetensors format
build_gemma3_model_from_orbax: build a Gemma3 HuggingFace model by converting Orbax checkpoint weights with specified variant and dtype
convert_siglip_vision_weights: convert SigLIP vision encoder weights from Orbax format to HuggingFace transformer naming convention
convert_transformer_decoder_weights: convert transformer decoder block weights from Orbax format to HuggingFace Gemma3 text model naming
get_gemma3_chat_template: get the Jinja2 chat template string for Gemma3 instruction-tuned model conversation formatting
